markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (>99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set, full agreement; but blur-degraded section with a tumor-at-margin call [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%; others <1% | Near-certain, one class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0, no flag | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Neighbors unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · scarce here; low tubules link to invasive in concept model [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · scored above typical; spot check failed · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · above typical; small contribution · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · slightly above typical; small contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion vs random: 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), includes 0; not shown faithful. Case leans on mitoses (Unreliable, 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) distorts nuclear detail behind concept scores and probabilities.
- Reliability-error AUROC is modest (0.69, CI 0.58–0.87) on a small test set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 8, 0**: top heatmap contributions; confirm invasive tumor, not blur artifact.
2. **Region 11**: sparse tubules and pleomorphism; confirm invasive growth pattern.
3. **Regions 0, 4 (medial), 9 (inferior)**: margin strips called tumor; verify at the edge.
